section_path_text: MMI Daily Iron Ore Index Report July 14 2026
summary:
Main
Today, the iron ore market showed relatively strong performance on the Dalian Commodity Exchange (DCE), with the benchmark contractI2609 finally closing at 760.5 yuan/ton, up 1.81%. Qingdao port spot prices remained firm, rising by approximately 10-12 yuan/ton from the previous trading day. Traders became more active, while steel mills, apart from rigid replenishment, showed generally low purchasing willingness.
